item.title: 【General Music Discussion】My blog about music from the 80s, 90s, and 00s.
item.description:
I present to you my free download blog where you can find music from the 80s, 90s, and 00s up to the present day. The albums I post are from styles such as new wave, cold wave, pop rock, EBM, industrial, synth-pop, new beat, acid house, makina, techno, trance, goth rock, psychobilly, etc.




Enjoy the site.
Regards.
